page.overview:
What is Alolan Exeggutor?

Exeggutor is known as the Coconut Pokémon. This Pokémon looks like a walking palm tree with three yellow coconut-like heads. Each of its head shows a different expression and has its own will. It has two stubby legs, and its feet have two white claws and yellow soles. If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an Exeggcute. They use Telepathy to discuss their plan before coming to a joint decision.

Alolan Exeggutor is much taller and slim than its Kantonian counterpart. It has a tail with the end being a coconut with an additional face. This face looks overall different from the other three faces because it is green and has smaller eyes and a closed mouth.

Kantonian Exeggutor live in herds and has been given the reputation as the "Walking Jungle" due to them migrating sometimes. Tales have been told that one of Exeggutor's heads would fall off and form an Exeggcute, when this happens it will emit a telepathic call almost immediately to attract five other Exeggcute and become a group. The three heads of an Exeggutor always think independently and rarely bicker with one another. Exeggutor having a stout body is the result of cooler climates. Their three heads each speak their minds all at once. As a result, Exeggutor can be very noisy at times. They use telepathy to plan amongst themselves before acting. They are very friendly, both between their heads and to others, so it is rare for them to ever argue. When they do, however, Exeggutor will become confused, especially if they try to move in different directions at once. Though not aggressive, Exeggutor are capable of defending themselves when attacked with a variety of moves, including techniques such as Egg Bomb and the rare Barrage. Focusing on the same target with all three ends results in a triple-strength attack. They are rarely threatened, though, as their herds give them strength in numbers; few ever want to anger entire "forests". Exeggutor become quite sluggish when deprived of sunlight, and forests of them will quiet down on cloudy days.

Alolan Exeggutor thrives well in the Alola region. The locals there often take pride in Exeggutor, stating that it was originally meant to look like the taller appearance it bears in Alola. Exeggutor living in Alola have given up their psychic powers in exchange for draconic powers that have been long dormant for many years. The main reason for Exeggutor gaining -type powers is the strong sunlight from Alola. These heads help them spot opponents sneaking up from behind, though they can also attack as well if necessary. Though most predators stay far away from these giant Pokémon, some have learned to take advantage of their height, zipping around their feet until they loose balance and keel over. They attack foes by swinging around their heads like giant whips, though this action makes them dizzy as well.
